تصطلحي (form VIII)
# تَصْطَلِحِي (taṣṭaliḥī) /tasˤ.tˤa.li.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# تُصْطَلَحِي (tuṣṭalaḥī) /tusˤ.tˤa.la.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
